text:
deploy-bot: initiating release v4.2 -> canary (apac-southeast1) at 21:10 UTC. canary=3%. smoke suite = synthwatch + prefix-probe (sampled). pre-deploy tasks: kv-prefill started, will trigger warmup hook. changewindow moved 30m earlier per infra ask. dashboard: https://dash/release/1774302468 :rocket:
mira: noted. since window changed, recommend lowering synthwatch fanout from 30 -> 8 for first pass to reduce blast radius.
ajay: agreed. also run tokenizer primer job before smoke -- saw cold tokenizer tail last week. I'll queue it.
tomas: FYI we have a weekend job that nukes some caches around 21:15 UTC; double-check it's disabled for this host group.
sre-oncall: quick heads-up, I'll watch p95/embed and 5xx counts during rollout. will create incident if >+20% or >10 5xx in 10m.

deploy-bot: kv-prefill done. tokenizer-primer scheduled (duration ~8m). starting synthwatch (fanout=8) at 21:22 UTC.
mira: pulling initial probe results: synthwatch (apac-southeast1) 40 samples -> p50 98ms, p95 380ms (baseline 300ms), errors 6 (mostly 429/503).
ajay: that's higher than expected. can we see whether tokenization warmup completed before probes?
tomas: logs show token-primer started at 21:22:30, finished 21:24:20. probes started 21:22:40. warmup overlapped with probes -> race.
mira: hold canary for apac-southeast1. DO NOT RAMP. leave other regions untouched.

deploy-bot: action: isolated-pin apac-southeast1 -> v4.1 at 21:30 UTC. other regions continue. notified @mira. incident created: INC-20260323-8812 (low).
ajay: rerun plan: restart tokenizer-primer then rerun synthwatch with fanout=8 and samples=40. command:
```
# restart primer and rerun smoke
deploy-bot run-primer --region apac-southeast1 --timeout 900
deploy-bot rerun-smoke --suite synthwatch --region apac-southeast1 --fanout 8 --samples 40
```
tomas: also add a 30s delay between primer completion and probe start in the deploy orchestrator to avoid overlap.
mira: executing rerun now. will post results in ~10m. tagging @ajay for primer logs.

deploy-bot: primer restarted. estimated completion 21:43 UTC. probes paused until confirmation.
ajay: primer logs: tokenizer cache warmed for 18 nodes, primed keys ~1.2M, no errors.
mira: synthwatch rerun results: 40 samples -> p50 96ms, p95 310ms, errors 0. within baseline. good to proceed.

ajay: recommendation: unpin apac-southeast1 and continue slow ramp: 3% -> 15% over 25m. watch for tail latency for 45m.
mira: unpinning and scheduling conservative ramp at 21:55 UTC. keeping synthwatch sampling active for 60m.
sre-oncall: closing INC-20260323-8812 as mitigated; added note: ensure primer finishes before any probes start in off-hours rollouts.
tomas: follow-up ticket: RUN-20260323-12 to add 30s buffer and optional primer-run flag to deploy manifest.
mira: adding a release-note entry and changelog blurb: "v4.2: added tokenizer primer pre-smoke; conservative apac ramp due to warmup overlap". also updating the deployment checklist: `- ensure primer complete >30s before smoke`
deploy-bot: rollout resumed. status: apac-southeast1 unpinned -> v4.2 (ramp 3%->15% over 25m). summary: https://dash/release/1774302468/summary :white_check_mark:
